excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, Doubao launched multiple updates around productivity scenarios, and the "Work Task Mode" interface has also been upgraded. A new sidebar workbench has been added to the right of the "Chat" page, consolidating task-related resources in a multi-tab format, allowing AI conversations and hands-on operations to happen on the same screen without frequent window switching. According to the introduction, the sidebar workbench supports opening local files, Feishu documents, web pages, as well as code, applications, and terminals, covering the main scenarios of daily office work and application development. For long tasks, multiple outputs generated in the conversation—such as apps, files, and images—are displayed side by side as tabs for one-click viewing. Each conversation has its own independent workbench, which automatically restores its previous state when switching tasks, preventing scattered outputs and hard-to-trace history in long conversations. In application development scenarios, the sidebar workbench supports real-time code preview. After generating a webpage, users can click the "Edit" button directly to fine-tune specific details without regenerating the entire page. For office documents, Feishu documents, PPT, and Excel can all be opened directly in the sidebar workbench, with model-generated content instantly updating to the document, eliminating the need for copy-pasting and secondary saves. In addition, the model can directly browse and operate web pages in the sidebar workbench, autonomously completing searches, clicks, page turns, and information extraction based on user instructions, and summarizing based on web content. excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, Doubao ha lanzado varias actualizaciones en torno a escenarios de productividad, y la interfaz del «modo de tareas de trabajo» también se ha mejorado. En el lado derecho de la página «Conversación» se ha añadido un banco de trabajo lateral, que unifica los recursos relacionados con las tareas mediante múltiples pestañas, permitiendo que la conversación con IA y las operaciones reales se realicen en la misma pantalla, sin necesidad de cambiar con frecuencia entre múltiples ventanas. Según se ha informado, el banco de trabajo lateral admite abrir archivos locales, documentos de Feishu, páginas web en línea, así como código, aplicaciones y terminal, cubriendo los principales escenarios de trabajo diario y desarrollo de aplicaciones. Para tareas largas, las aplicaciones, archivos, imágenes y otros productos generados en la conversación se muestran en paralelo en forma de pestañas, con solo hacer clic para verlos; cada conversación tiene su propio banco de trabajo independiente, y al cambiar de tarea se restaura automáticamente.

items.title: 携手韶音，光帆的「AI OS 野心」已经藏不住了
items.raw_excerpt: 2026 年 8 月 18 日，韶音在上海举办媒体沟通会，正式发布开放式耳机新品 OpenFit 2 AI。而光帆科技作为韶音重要的技术合作伙伴，为本款产品提供了 AI 技术支撑。 沟通会上，韶音宣布与光帆科技达成 AI 技术合作，将在 OpenFit 2 AI 中上线基于光帆自研 AI OS 的效率功能合集 ——“AI 实验室”，为智能对话、日程待办、快记快查、智能消息等创新类 AI 能力提供技术支撑，助力韶音为强沟通人群打造更高效的 AI 耳机体验。值得关注的是， 这是光帆 AI 技术能力首次正式落地第三方头部硬件品牌，标志着其系统化 AI 能力已从自有产品验证，进阶为可向行业伙伴输出。 基于光帆自研 AI OS 的效率功能合集——“AI 实验室”，即将在韶音 OpenFit 2 AI 耳机上线。 目前 AI 硬件正加速进入端侧规模化落地阶段。据 The Business Research Company 预测，2026 年全球 AI 耳机市场规模将达到 74.2 亿美元，2030 年有望增长至 173.4 亿美元。 在中国市场，开放式耳机是增长最快的细分品类之一，IDC 数据显示，2025 年中国开放式耳机出货量达 2996 万台，同比增长 20.2%。作为该品类的全球头部品牌，韶音此次与光帆的合作，也代表着开放式耳机率先从单点 AI 功能走向系统化 AI 能力。 与此同时，AI 硬件的竞争焦点正在迁移：接入大模型不再是稀缺能力，真正拉开体验差距的是 AI 体系化能力。多名业内人士对雷峰网·鲸犀表示，过去几年 AI 在耳机上的落地多为降噪、佩戴监测等单点功能，而真正的分水岭在于 AI 能否提供更主动智能、更多样化的能力，并依托系统化支撑实现跨应用调度。此次光帆与韶音的合作，正是这一行业趋势的代表性落地。 据雷峰网·鲸犀了解，光帆此次在 OpenFit 2 AI 耳机上

excerpt_i18n.en: In recent years, as domestic competition intensifies and new models such as fully-managed services emerge, a growing number of domestic trade merchants have started going overseas in search of new business opportunities. At the same time, many brands that grew in overseas markets are now strengthening their presence in the domestic market, such as consumer electronics brands Anker and OnePlus. Under this two-way flow, the integrated development of domestic and foreign trade is becoming the new normal for more and more enterprises. According to data from the Ministry of Commerce, as many as 87,000 industrial enterprises above designated size have achieved integrated domestic and foreign trade operations. Operating on both domestic and international fronts brings double the opportunities, but it also exponentially increases operational complexity. Domestic e-commerce, cross-border e-commerce, B2B, and B2C each have completely different operating logics; the demographics and consumer preferences across different platforms and channels also vary greatly. The interweaving of these dimensions sharply increases operational difficulty. Relying solely on human effort is no longer enough to handle such a complex landscape. Business can be conducted across multiple platforms, but can management and operations be handled by just one? Driven by this strong demand, Accio, which already has 10 million users in the cross-border e-commerce space, has integrated mainstream domestic platforms including Taobao, Tmall, Pinduoduo, JD.com, and Douyin Store. With multiple e-commerce platforms, a single AI workstation has emerged. E-commerce AI Agents are now beginning to integrate domestic and foreign trade as well. Accio was originally launched by Alibaba International Digital Commerce Group as an AI Agent specifically designed to help foreign trade B2B merchants—business owners in overseas trade—do business.
